scope: Central incoming frequency cell, angle-integrated scalar 2p event kernel with positive red/interior/blue deposition.

decision.interpretation: The exact-event line-centre column reproduces the absolute Hummer opacity and exact recoil mean with positive deposition. The next stage extends the control-variate construction to all source cells and angular harmonic blocks.

limitations: Only the central incoming frequency cell is integrated.
Outgoing directions are angle-integrated; no anisotropic harmonic block is deposited.
The integrated reverse kernel is obtained from a shared PT-audited conductance, not a second full QMC integral.
The scalar amplitude remains the unresolved 2p pole+crossed model.
The no-recoil Hummer column is used solely as a variance-reduction control variate.

next_stage.name: PR01B1B1_full_frequency_harmonic_deposition
tasks: Extend the common-random-number exact/no-recoil correction to all 17 incoming cells.
Deposit Legendre moments through the adaptive L=12/20/24 harmonic policy.
Run independent reverse QMC on selected high-weight cell pairs.
Couple red/blue exterior event transfers to BackgroundSnapshot traces.
Require full-kernel number, equilibrium, four-force and quadrature gates.
